evidence.quote: We investigated whether the overall distribution of NK cells or NK cell subsets in tissues varied according to age or CMV serostatus, which are known to affect lymphocyte subset differentiation and immunosenescence ( Nikolich-Žugich, 2018 ; Pawelec and Derhovanessian, 2011 ).
Cells were washed once with cold FACS-buffer (PBS with 2% heat-inactivated FCS and 2 mM EDTA) and stained in a two-step process.
